title: Boss with its fastener: a pan-head M3 screw at each boss, in its own component

steps.comment: no drafts and no fillets: every piece is a cylinder

expect.note: As plastic_boss_enclosure, plus the screws: a pan head of the counterbore's diameter - 0.5 (r 3) and 0.6 d high (1.8) on the counterbore's floor 2.05 above the parting plane, the shank r 1.5 down to 0.5 mm above the pilot hole's bottom (z 1.5): 2.05 + 18.5 = 20.55 long: pi 3^2 1.8 + pi 1.5^2 20.55 = 196.153191 each. Enclosure 60x40x20 shelled 2 (top open) = 48000 - 56*36*18 = 11712; lid 60x40x10 shelled 2 (bottom open) = 24000 - 56*36*8 = 7872. Per point, thread side (enclosure, clearance 0.05): shank r 3.75 from z 19.95 to the floor z 2 (17.95), its tip carried on 0.9 into the lid's recess, minus the pilot r 1.2 from the spigot top to 1 mm above the outside (0.9 + 17.95 + 1): pi (3.75^2 17.95 + 3.75^2 0.9 - 1.2^2 19.85) = 742.968206. Head side (lid): shank r 5 from z 20.05 to the lid's inside z 28 (7.95), minus the recess r 3.85 (the mate's 7.5 + 2 x 0.1) 1 deep, the hole r 1.7 for 1 mm, the counterbore r 3.25 from z 22.05 to the outside (7.95): pi (5^2 7.95 - 3.85^2 - 1.7^2 - 3.25^2 7.95) = 304.940654. Two points. The expect is the lid (the head side's body).
